sections.name: Intro (riff)
sections.notes: Main E riff x2. Kick and floor tom under the riff, hat on 2 & 4.

sections.name: Verse 1
sections.notes: Ride-based, doubled kick, ghost notes. 12-bar: E7 x8, B7 x2, E7 x2.
sections.sheet:
E
If you lose your money, great God, don't lose your mind
       E
If you lose your money, great God, don't lose your mind
            B7                                      E
And if you lose your woman, please don't fool with mine
sections.lyrics:

If you lose your money, great God, don't lose your mind
And if you lose your woman, please don't fool with mine
